instruction: A torch-lit cavern hoard: a sleeping dragon coiled on mounds of gold coins, overflowing treasure chests, scattered goblets, crowns and gem piles, embedded swords and shields, broken pillars, stalactites, glinting jewels in wall crevices, and warm torchlight flickering across the gold as the dragon's chest slowly rises and falls with curls of nostril smoke.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Dragon Hoard Cave. A torch-lit cavern hoard: a sleeping dragon coiled on mounds of gold coins, overflowing treasure chests, scattered goblets, crowns and gem piles, embedded swords and shields, broken pillars, stalactites, glinting jewels in wall crevices, and warm torchlight flickering across the gold as the dragon's chest slowly rises and falls with curls of nostril smoke. Style: epic fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
